name: at-tests
title: Axial Tilt test marker
author: Sparr
description: Marks a game as running the Axial Tilt test suite. Holds no prototypes: it exists so control.lua can tell a test run from a player's game, since info.json keeps test/ out of the published package and the fixtures would not be there to require. Published with the mod's source on GitHub, but never to the mod portal.
